tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: Consider a circular disc of radius 20 cm with centre located at the origin. A circular hole of radius 5 cm is cut from this disc in such a way that the edge of the hole touches the edge of the disc. The distance of centre of mass of residual or remaining disc from the origin will be

solution.text: $\text { mass of disc }=\mathrm{m}$ $\text { mass of cut part }=\frac{m}{16}$ $X_{c o m}=\frac{m \times 0-\frac{m}{16} \times 15}{m-\frac{m}{16}}$ $=1 \mathrm{~cm} .$
